scope: Every item ID present in docs/assets/clog-luck.js DATA at review time.
calibration: Mature/late-game Group Ironman. Impact is first-copy practical utility/progression. Rarity, GE price, RNG evidence, duplicate value, teammate coverage, synergy and look-elsewhere effects are separate layers.

scale.1.5-2.99: meaningful niche, skilling or stepping-stone progression
scale.3-4.99: strong useful progression or specialist endgame utility
